author: Petris
quote: Open world is good but not what i expect for 13 year dev time.. the story is simple and cliche with not interesting characters or complexity and the worst part is that the game is full of bugs and glitches i always end up inside graphics or textures and its so anticlimactic idk i had a lot of hype for the title and i was disappointed

author: Petris
quote: Just play the freaking game, this game is the definition of what a video game is.. just like ocarina of time did in that time. Its the reason why we loved in first place with the thing that we call video games, is a reason to keep playing video games, it reminds you why you started playing video games.. it just has that feeling..
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
